mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM customer c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1) AS customerCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM platform_member pm WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.status = 1) AS platformCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tenant_member tm WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 1 AND tm.deleted_at IS NULL) AS tenantCount
